title: Importing a V3000 file whose or group number the document already uses keeps both as separate groups, gives the new one a free number and reports the change

parameters.source:
Stereo


  0  0  0     0  0            999 V3000
M  V30 BEGIN CTAB
M  V30 COUNTS 4 3 0 0 0
M  V30 BEGIN ATOM
M  V30 1 C 5.0000 -5.0000 0.0000 0
M  V30 2 F 5.0000 -3.5000 0.0000 0
M  V30 3 Cl 6.3000 -5.7500 0.0000 0
M  V30 4 Br 3.7000 -5.7500 0.0000 0
M  V30 END ATOM
M  V30 BEGIN BOND
M  V30 1 1 1 2
M  V30 2 1 1 3 CFG=1
M  V30 3 1 1 4
M  V30 END BOND
M  V30 BEGIN COLLECTION
M  V30 MDLV30/STEREL1 ATOMS=(1 1)
M  V30 END COLLECTION
M  V30 END CTAB
M  END
